version.changelog: v1.4.0: Fix 10 SkillSpector findings - memory reads OPT-IN + P0 sanitization + wording fixes

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed session-handoff helper that writes a project handoff file and uses opt-in IDE memory/profile scans, with no evidence of hidden execution, exfiltration, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill can aggregate project context, user messages, env var names/status, and optional IDE metadata into a handoff file; this is disclosed and bounded by sanitization/consent rules, but users should review the generated file before sharing or committing it.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown-only documentation/templates with a normal ClawHub install command; no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or install-time hooks were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md frontmatter limits activation to explicit phrases and says not to use it for unrelated coding or new-project work; sensitive IDE-specific scanning is repeatedly gated on explicit consent and decline paths are documented.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, cron/service installation, privilege escalation, network use, subprocess use, or tool hijacking was found; the only durable state is the user-visible handoff file, which may overwrite an existing handoff path as disclosed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to branch a coding session into a new conversation by generating a structured handoff document and startup prompt; reading project/session context, writing a handoff file, and optional IDE memory/profile context are coherent with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a project handoff document created. Grant IDE memory/profile/config access narrowly, review the generated handoff before sharing or committing it, and be aware that the default handoff path may overwrite an existing file.
llm.findings:
[RA1] expected: The cited 'update SKILL.md' text is in a customization guide for adapting templates to a new IDE, not an instruction for runtime self-modification or safety bypass.
[RA2] expected: Writing a handoff document is the core function and is disclosed before execution; the artifact does not install background persistence or unauthorized cross-session hooks.
[SQP-1] expected: The README lists broad Chinese trigger phrases, but SKILL.md narrows activation to those exact phrases and explicitly excludes general coding, new projects, and non-handoff session management.
[SQP-3] expected: The language-related instructions are repository/IDE template conventions and do not create security authority; they may affect localization quality but do not indicate malicious or hidden behavior.
[T05] expected: The artifact does request broad handoff metadata, including env var names and optional IDE memory/profile/config context; this is sensitive but disclosed, value-redacted, consent-gated for IDE-specific files, and aligned with the handoff purpose.
